scope: Superseding Stage5A settlement architecture; local development and isolated PostgreSQL tests

settlementScenarios: settlement integration stays disabled and has no public callback or checkout route
registered initiation, pending and failed provider outcomes never credit or change a service
unverified, tampered, stale and lookup-failed events cannot post financial records
authoritative payment, provider/account, amount, currency and customer bindings are validated
settlement and ledger credit commit once under replay, duplicate events and concurrent delivery
event ID reuse with different content conflicts and out-of-order failures cannot undo settled funds
equivalent provider timestamp precision does not reject a duplicate settlement
a posting failure rolls back receipt/payment/credit together and safe redelivery can succeed
wallet zero/positive and service active/inactive are four independent valid states; no auto-renew
settled wallet funds renew an expired suspended service only after explicit customer and staff actions
registration is idempotent and rejects legacy consumed payment references without changing history
database rejects orphan settlement credits, incomplete settlement and financial-history changes
database rejects missing settlement proof even with otherwise matching event and ledger allocation

provider.testProtocol: Test-only SIMULATED authenticated envelope plus independent authoritative lookup fixture; never wired to production application
